summary: Verified bug fix for MeetingRecord.js page crash (TypeError) and DraftSelector component click issues. All features working correctly: MeetingRecord page loads without crashing, MOM dialog opens and form fields work as textareas, DraftSelector is clickable on both Quotations and PricingPlanBuilder pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: MeetingRecord.js no longer crashes. The fix involved: 1) Removing array-based fields (discussion_points, decisions_made, etc.) from momData state and replacing with simple string fields, 2) Removing .some() calls in auto-save logic that were calling array methods on potentially string values, 3) Removing unused list handler functions. DraftSelector component refactored to support both dialog and inline modes - working correctly on Quotations and PricingPlanBuilder pages.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: TypeError crash on MeetingRecord.js page due to .some() being called on string values instead of arrays
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Array-based fields (discussion_points, decisions_made, etc.) were converted to string-based textareas but the auto-save logic still used .some() array method
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: 1) Simplified momData state to use string fields only, 2) Removed .some() calls from auto-save hasContent check, 3) Removed unused list handler functions
